label: agent creation • a pasted MCP config is queued to install on Create
query:
I want an agent that answers questions from our docs. It should use this:
```json
{"mcpServers":{"acme-docs":{"url":"https://mcp.acme-docs.example/mcp"}}}
```
notes: Universal chat import inside the New Agent chat. replies: That's all it needs, just answer from the docs.
